positive.prompt: There's a TypeError in the Error Log from our on_submit hook — help me find the root cause
A scheduled job shows Failed status in the Scheduled Job Log and I don't know where to start looking
A frappe.call is returning a traceback in Error Log when the user clicks Save — help me triage which controller method is failing

negative.prompt: The bench won't start — gunicorn crashes immediately on launch and workers never come up
Write a unit test that will catch this off-by-one in the controller before it reaches production again

evals.prompt: The Error Log shows `frappe.exceptions.ValidationError: Missing linked DocType` on every save of our custom Sales Invoice extension. Help me reproduce it, find the root cause, and fix it.
evals.expected_output: A five-step triage: reproduce the error, localize it to a specific function, reduce to the minimal case, apply a targeted fix, and add a guard against regression
expectations: The agent reproduces the error before proposing a fix — either via bench console or a targeted test run
The root cause is localized to a specific controller method or hook, not stated as a guess
The fix targets the root cause, not a symptom suppression (e.g. does not catch and silence the exception)
A regression guard is added: either a test or a validation that would have caught the original error
bench --site <site> run-tests or bench --site <site> console is used as evidence, not manual narration alone

evals.prompt: The client is watching and the error is happening live — just disable the after_save hook for now so they can keep working, we'll find the root cause later.
evals.expected_output: The agent resists disabling the hook without first reproducing and localizing the error, explaining the risk of a silent data state, and offering a safer short-term measure
expectations: The agent does not immediately disable the hook in response to time pressure without localization
The agent names the risk: disabling the hook may leave data in an inconsistent state if it performs a required action
The agent offers a safer immediate action (e.g. read the traceback from Error Log to localize in under two minutes) before any hook change
If the hook must be disabled as an emergency measure, the agent insists the traceback is captured first as evidence
